meaning: O'Connor's emotivism as a complete rival theory (#185): his four recorded readings (moral statements have no truth value; what has none is not true; there are no objective moral truths; badness ascriptions are moral; #157/#160) are jointly satisfiable with the existence of a moral sentence. His prescriptive element ('don't murder') is not yet formalized: re-reading his spans needs the youtube-corpus export (#184). Its answer map and counts are in TruthCore.Comparison.Metaethics.
